summary: Phase 4c frontend + backend regression (iteration 12). Backend: test_phase4c_growth.py 24/25 pass (only failure: blank 'New popup' create -> 422). Frontend tested at 1920 and 390 with a TEST admin (2FA via helper, session cookie injected): Popups admin (templates, editor tabs, live preview, server field errors, save toast + warning, Go live/Pause, Results drawer, Copy, Delete confirm), public popup (shows on home for logged-out visitor, consent-gated form + thank-you, Close + not shown again in session, never on /sign-in, /admin, /account/billing, /unsubscribe, /newsletter/confirm; modal = bottom sheet at 390, slide-in above bottom tabs, no overflow), footer sign-up (disabled until consent, same neutral message), confirm + unsubscribe pages (bad/missing/valid/reused tokens), E-mail list admin (tiles, filter, Remove confirm, CSV), Integrations (provider select incl. Emergent managed, Send me a test, list sync save/test/reset, owner-only tracking notice, webhook add/https validation/secret dialog/test/turn off/new secret/delete/recent deliveries), Analytics (all 6 cards, 7/30/90 reload, CSV for all 6 reports), Health alerts card (No open alerts + Check now), cookie banner (No thanks -> essential, Allow optional -> all, no gtag/fbq scripts), beacon 204 on public routes and none on /admin. Fixed 1 small UI bug (missing-token message). Found 3 real bugs + several minor ones.

critical.issue: Always 422 'Add a title or some text.' because popups.create validates blank() whose content is empty. The 'New popup' button (no template chosen) can never create a popup; UI only shows toast 'Some fields need fixing.'

minor.issue: Popup sign-ups counted twice: popups.submit() records 'submit' server-side and PopupHost.act('submit') also posts event 'submit'. One real sign-up on TEST popup gave submit=2, sign-up rate 200% in list/Analytics. Remove one of the two (simplest: don't track() when ev === 'submit' in components/Popups.jsx act).

UUID paths are not normalised: '/match/2c690161-8aa0-...' stored raw, others stored half-replaced like '/match/:idf93e-2c95-...' and '/league/:ida56-00d6-...'. Pages report/CSV fragments per match. Use a UUID-aware regex (e.g. /[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f-]{27}|/[0-9a-f-]{12,}).
With no rows the CSV is just the BOM, no header line.

Re-subscribing an unsubscribed address sets status pending but keeps the old confirmed_at (admin table shows a Confirmed date on a pending row); confirm-mail idem key is per hour so a re-subscribe in the same hour sends no new confirm e-mail.

ui_bugs.issue: Fails every time (see backend critical) - toast 'Some fields need fixing.'

Bottom banner (owner's 'Upgrade banner') and slide-in popups sit on top of the cookie banner; elementFromPoint at cookie-accept returns the popup, Playwright click times out. Visitor must close the popup before they can choose Allow optional / No thanks.

ui_bugs.component: Popup editor 'Who and how often' tab
ui_bugs.issue: Label says 'one per line, * = anything' but '*' is rejected by the server ('Up to 30 paths like /finder or /teams/*'); '/*' is required. Fix the label/hint or accept '*'.

/newsletter/confirm and /unsubscribe with no token showed 'Something went wrong on our side.' because the synthetic error had no code (sayError treats no code as server error). Added code LINK_EXPIRED / TOKEN_INVALID; now shows the intended text.

integration_issues.issue: Dev StrictMode runs usePageBeacon twice per route -> duplicate page_view rows (two '/' rows 1 ms apart) and pv counter doubled (affects 'pageviews' trigger). Production build unaffected. Beacon also fires on /sign-in, /unsubscribe, /newsletter/confirm (only /admin skipped) - consider reusing PRIVATE_PATHS.
With zero rows DataState shows generic 'Nothing here yet.' so the card's note and the utm_source hint never render.

action_items: Make 'New popup' work: create drafts without requiring content (validate content on save/go-live) or seed blank() with a placeholder title
Stop double-counting popup submits (client track + server record)
At 390px keep popups from covering the cookie banner (wait until consent chosen, or stack/offset, or higher z-index for the banner)
Fix pages_include hint ('*' vs '/*') or accept '*'
Minor: header-only CSV for empty acquisition export; clear confirmed_at on re-subscribe; sources card empty state; wrap Confirm onConfirm deletes in try/catch
Owner popup 'Newsletter sign-up' (6ae01aabb9a354f428999af6) still has ab.group 'test-t12ab' left by an earlier test run - owner should clear it (testing agent did not touch owner popups)
critical_code_review_comments: components/Popups.jsx act(): track(open.id, 'submit') duplicates server-side record in popups.submit()
admin/Popups.jsx, Newsletter.jsx, Integrations.jsx: Confirm onConfirm async handlers have no try/catch - a failed delete/remove leaves an unhandled rejection and no error toast
admin/Integrations.jsx AudienceCard: list_id state starts '' and is always sent on Save, so saving after only changing provider may overwrite a saved list id (backend behaviour not verified)
lib/api.getBlob error text is 'Could not load that image.' - CSV export failures (non-403) would show that message
Headless Playwright traffic is filtered as bot by analytics.track (collect returns 204 but stores nothing) - expected, but means UI tests can't verify realtime counts

success_rate.frontend: ~88% (core flows pass; New popup broken, cookie banner overlap at 390, double-count stats)

rca of the issue: New popup: popups.create() runs validate({**blank(), **data}) and validate requires title or body; blank() has neither. Double submit: popups.submit() calls record(db,pid,'submit') and the client PopupHost onDone->act('submit')->track(id,'submit'). Missing-token message: EmailLinks built {error:{message}} without code; lib/errors.sayError returns the generic server-error text when code is missing.
